About

Your independent Berlin guide to hotels in every district

About Berlin Hotels is an editorially curated travel and hotel guide for Berlin. We bring hotels, districts, attractions and itineraries together in one place - so you can find the right place to stay faster.

How we pick hotels

Our hotel picks are handpicked and deliberately span every price point and style - from grand hotels by the Brandenburg Gate to budget houses with great transit links. We vet every property against verifiable, publicly documented facts (location, amenities, history). We don't invent details. Live prices and availability come straight from Booking.com via embedded maps, so you always see current data.

What we stand for

  • ✓Factual accuracy: based on public sources, checked regularly.
  • ✓Local focus: recommendations by district and trip type, not anonymous lists.
  • ✓Freshness: prices and availability are live, not stale tables.
  • ✓Transparency: affiliate links are clearly labeled.

How we're funded

To keep this guide free, we work with affiliate partners such as Booking.com (via Stay22) and GetYourGuide. If you book through one of our links we earn a small commission - at no extra cost to you. These commissions don't influence which properties we recommend; our selection stays editorial.

Contact & feedback

Missing a hotel, spotted outdated info, or have a tip? Email us at info(at)about-berlin-hotels.de. Full provider details are in the imprint.
